description: Use when the user asks what tickets actually sold for on an event, or before claiming nothing has traded. Returns recent completed deals from the XP marketplace with the per-ticket price and how long ago each cleared. An empty result is a real answer: no verified transfers in the window. Useful before deciding whether to make an offer or wait for a price drop. One sale is one sale -- do not generalise from a single clear.

event_id.description: Event identifier from search_market or search_events.
